goal:
Write a one-shot script /home/workspace/logs/bulk_promote.py that directly promotes all 3151 unpromoteed mcp_registry candidates into mcp_server_registry in batches of 500.

Logic:
1. SELECT id, candidate_name, candidate_url, candidate_description FROM mcp_discovery_candidates WHERE promoted=false AND discovered_status='active' AND discovered_in_directory='mcp_registry'
2. For each batch of 500: INSERT INTO mcp_server_registry (server_id, name, url, description, verdict, trust_score, created_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), candidate_name, candidate_url, candidate_description, 'unknown', 0.5, now() FROM batch ON CONFLICT(url) DO NOTHING
3. UPDATE mcp_discovery_candidates SET promoted=true, reviewed_at=now() WHERE id IN (batch_ids)
4. Log before/after count of mcp_server_registry
5. Run immediately when script is executed - not a daemon

Also fix candidate_promoter_daemon.py MAX_PAGES constant from 50 to 500.
constraints: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on registry insert
Log registry count before and after
